_about: SignInSession answers of /v1/setup/sign-in (BOSSAPP-769 contract), one per state the console draws.

waiting.headline: Waiting for you to approve
waiting.fix: Open the page, enter the code, approve.

waiting_for_code.headline: Waiting for the code
waiting_for_code.fix: Approve in the browser, then paste the code it shows.

signed_in.headline: Signed in on the BOSS server

failed.headline: Codex refused the sign-in
failed.fix: Sign in again with the ChatGPT account that has Codex.

expired.headline: The code expired
expired.fix: Press Try again for a new code.

cancelled.headline: Sign-in cancelled
cancelled.fix: Press Sign in to start again.

refused_not_installed.headline: Grok is not on the BOSS server
refused_not_installed.fix: Install the grok CLI on the server, then sign in.
